segment.source: Basic slider. When range is true, display as dual thumb mode. When disable is true, the slider will not be interactable.
segment.target: 基础滑块。range 为 true 时显示为双滑块模式；disable 为 true 时滑块不可交互。

segment.source: Use tooltip.formatter to format content of Tooltip. If tooltip.formatter is null, hide it.
segment.target: 使用 tooltip.formatter 格式化 Tooltip 内容；当 tooltip.formatter 为 null 时隐藏提示。

segment.source: Set disabled as an array to disable individual handles in range mode. A disabled handle becomes a movement boundary that other handles cannot cross.
segment.target: 设置 disabled 为数组，可以单独禁用 range 模式下特定的 handle。禁用后该 handle 作为移动边界，其他 handle 无法越过。

segment.source: Using marks property to mark a graduated slider, use value or defaultValue to specify the position of thumb. When included is false, means that different thumbs are coordinative. when step is null, users can only slide the thumbs onto marks.
segment.target: 使用 marks 属性标记带刻度滑块，使用 value 或 defaultValue 指定滑块位置。当 included 为 false 时，不同滑块相互独立；当 step 为 null 时，用户只能将滑块拖到刻度上。

segment.source: Combine multiple points in a range.
Slider supports single-value and range selection, horizontal or vertical orientation, snap-to-tick behavior, formatted tooltips, marks, included tracks, disabled states, and keyboard interaction.
segment.target: Slider 支持单值和范围选择、水平或垂直方向、按刻度吸附、格式化提示、刻度标记、包含轨道、禁用状态和键盘交互。

segment.source: Select a numeric value or range from a continuous or graduated track.
segment.target: 从连续或带刻度的轨道中选择数值或范围。

segment.source: RangeValues defaults to TwoWay binding, so range changes update the ViewModel without an explicit binding mode.
segment.target: RangeValues 默认双向绑定，拖动范围会直接更新 ViewModel，无需显式设置绑定模式。

segment.source: Slider handle control element with absolute positioning, size, outline, user selection, background color, border shadow, border radius, cursor style and transition animation
segment.target: 滑块控制点元素，设置绝对定位、尺寸、轮廓线、用户选择、背景色、边框阴影、圆角、光标样式和过渡动画

segment.source: Use owner-scoped selectors and generated Semantic Part styles to customize the published rail, tracks, track and handle parts.
segment.target: 使用 owner 作用域选择器与生成的 Semantic Part 样式，定制已发布的背景轨道、多段轨道容器、轨道选取条与控制点 Part。
自定义语义结构的样式

segment.source: Background rail element with absolute positioning, background color, border radius and transition animation styles
segment.target: 背景轨道元素，设置绝对定位、背景色、圆角和过渡动画样式

segment.source: Root element with relative positioning, height, margin, padding, cursor style and touch action control
segment.target: 根元素，设置相对定位、高度、边距、内边距、光标样式和触摸事件控制

segment.source: Track selection bar element with absolute positioning, background color, border radius and transition animation styles
segment.target: 轨道选取条元素，设置绝对定位、背景色、圆角和过渡动画样式

segment.source: Multi-segment track container element with absolute positioning and transition animation styles
segment.target: 多段轨道容器元素，设置绝对定位和过渡动画样式
